description: This file defines the 'EncryptedDocument' class which manages the encryption, decryption, and metadata handling of individual encrypted documents stored on disk. It handles secure reading and writing of encrypted content and metadata sections, utilizing AES-CTR encryption and HMAC-SHA256 authentication, with mechanisms for atomic file updates.

classes.name: EncryptedDocument
classes.description: Represents an encrypted document that handles encryption, decryption, metadata handling, and secure storage on disk.

methods.name: EncryptedDocument
methods.description: Constructor for creating an instance of EncryptedDocument with given document ID, file location, and cryptographic keys.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the File object representing the storage location of the encrypted document.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the file name as string representation.

methods.name: readMetadata
methods.description: Decrypts and returns the metadata section of the document as a JSONObject, verifying MAC and document ID.

methods.name: readContent
methods.description: Decrypts and reads the content section of the document, writing it into the provided parcel pipe.

methods.name: writeMetadataAndContent
methods.description: Encrypts and writes both the metadata and content sections into the file atomically, reading content from the provided pipe.

methods.name: readSection
methods.description: Helper method to read and decrypt a section of the document, validating its MAC.

methods.name: writeSection
methods.description: Helper method to encrypt and write a section of data into the file.
